title: Storm at Ravenhurst
logline: Amidst a violent storm, a family gathers at Ravenhurst Manor only to find their patriarch murdered in a locked study, revealing secrets and lies that threaten to tear them apart.

setting.containment: A violent coastal storm. Roads flooded. Power intermittent.
tone_notes: Silence broken only by clocks and rain

cast.name: Beatrice Blackwood
cast.public_persona: Cold dignity, financially dependent on the victim
cast.private_secret: She was involved in a secret affair with the family physician.

relationships.note: Resentful of his control over her finances.
Desires to protect him from Edgar's manipulations.

alibi_windows.claim: She was in her room preparing for dinner.

cast.means_access: She has a key to the study.
cast.portrait_brief: A woman of poise, hiding her true feelings behind a mask of mourning.

cast.name: Julian Blackwood
cast.private_secret: He was in debt to dangerous people.

relationships.note: Resented his father's control over his life.
Flirted with her but didn't take her seriously.

alibi_windows.claim: He was in the library with Clara.

cast.means_access: He has access to the study but claims he was elsewhere.
cast.appearance_summary: Handsome but tired eyes, restless smile.
cast.portrait_brief: A young man caught between charm and desperation.

cast.name: Clara Finch

relationships.note: Knew his secrets and resented his treatment of staff.

alibi_windows.claim: She was in the study organizing files.

cast.means_access: She has a key to the study.
cast.portrait_brief: A woman of sharp intellect, burdened by secrets.

cast.name: Dr. Samuel Hargreaves
cast.private_secret: He was in love with Beatrice.

alibi_windows.claim: He was in the kitchen with the cook.

cast.means_access: He had access to the study through Beatrice.
cast.portrait_brief: A man of science, torn between duty and desire.

victim.name: Edgar Blackwood
victim.why_hated: Financial manipulation, blackmail, and quiet cruelty toward family and staff

detective.name: Inspector Alistair Crowe
detective.blind_spot: Underestimates the emotional motivations of the suspects.

solution.motive: To silence Edgar's threats of revealing her blackmail.
solution.method: Poison in the whiskey he drank during dinner.
solution.locked_room_explanation: Clara used a hidden key to access the study, then returned to her alibi.

red_herrings.label: The Stopped Clock
red_herrings.appears_as: A clue indicating the time of death.
red_herrings.truth: It stopped at the time of the murder but was merely a coincidence.
red_herrings.how_resolved: Inspector Crowe discovers it was merely a malfunction.

red_herrings.label: The Torn Letter
red_herrings.appears_as: A letter suggesting Edgar was going to cut off Julian financially.
red_herrings.truth: It was actually a letter of support, misinterpreted.
red_herrings.how_resolved: Crowe finds the complete letter hidden in Julian's belongings.

red_herrings.label: The Missing Key
red_herrings.appears_as: The key to the study thought to be lost.
red_herrings.truth: Clara had it all along, hidden in her belongings.
red_herrings.how_resolved: Crowe discovers it during a search of her things.

key_scenes: Arrival of guests at Ravenhurst Manor
chapter_plan.chapter_end_hook: A sudden power outage plunges the manor into darkness.
clues_to_seed: An overheard argument between Julian and Edgar.

key_scenes: Guests discover Edgar's body in the locked study
Initial reactions of shock and suspicion
chapter_plan.chapter_end_hook: A thunderclap echoes as the storm intensifies.
clues_to_seed: Wet footprints leading away from the study.

chapter_plan.purpose: Investigation deepens, red herrings are introduced.
key_scenes: Interrogation of Beatrice about her alibi
Julian's gambling debts come to light
chapter_plan.chapter_end_hook: A hidden letter is found, raising more questions.
clues_to_seed: The torn letter found in Julian's room.

key_scenes: Crowe confronts Clara about her knowledge of Edgar's secrets
The discovery of the missing key
Julian's confrontation with Clara about blackmail
clues_to_seed: A misfiled ledger found in the study.

key_scenes: Confrontation with Dr. Hargreaves about his relationship with Beatrice
chapter_plan.chapter_end_hook: A shocking revelation about Clara's motives.
clues_to_seed: The stopped clock is examined for fingerprints.

chapter_plan.chapter_end_hook: The storm begins to clear, symbolizing the end of the mystery.

clue_ledger.true_meaning: Merely a coincidence, unrelated to the murder.

clue_ledger.surface_interpretation: Could suggest financial wrongdoing by Julian.

clue_ledger.clue: Wet footprints where none should be

clue_ledger.true_meaning: Misleading; it was a supportive letter.

clue_ledger.surface_interpretation: Indicates someone could access the study.
Suggests tension between Julian and Edgar.

timeline.event: Dinner begins with all guests present.
Power outage occurs, guests are unsettled.
